patients.summary: Teacher in her late twenties with a BRCA2 mutation and a childhood Wilms tumor treated with left nephrectomy and abdominopelvic radiation, followed with high-risk breast MRI. Crohn disease is found by GI in early 2025 and controlled on adalimumab; in August 2026, after her last practice visit, a breast surgeon sees her for a left breast mass with biopsy pending.

documents.title: New Patient Intake Call
documents.author: front desk
documents.body: Caller is a 26 y/o teacher moving her primary care to us; prior PCP was across the river and she wants someone closer to Belchertown. Membership explained, she enrolled on the call. Mentions she carries a BRCA2 mutation and had a kidney tumor as a child, wants a doctor who will keep track of her screening. No current meds except a vitamin D supplement. Booked new patient physical 8/10, 1 hr slot, fasting labs same morning. Records release form emailed for her old office.

conditions.label: Hereditary breast and ovarian cancer syndrome (BRCA2 mutation carrier)
conditions.note: germline BRCA2 pathogenic variant found on testing after her mother's breast cancer

conditions.label: History of kidney cancer
conditions.note: stage II Wilms tumor at age 6 treated with left nephrectomy and abdominopelvic radiation, no evidence of disease since

medications.sig: Take 1 capsule (2000 units) by mouth daily

documents.title: New Patient Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
26 y/o woman, elementary school teacher, new to me. Feels well, no complaints, came mostly so someone is minding her cancer-risk screening.

Oncologic hx: Wilms tumor, stage II, at age 6 -> L nephrectomy plus abdominal/pelvic radiation at a children's hospital. Off surveillance for years, no recurrence. She does not have the treatment summary but thinks no further follow-up was set up after age 18. Single kidney.
Genetics: BRCA2 pathogenic variant, tested ~2017 after mom's diagnosis. Has had breast MRI yearly; last one last year at her old office, she says normal. Not yet discussed ovarian risk management in any detail.
FHx: mother breast ca at 45 (living). Maternal aunt ovarian ca at 52. Maternal grandmother breast ca at 68. Has an older sister.
PSH: L nephrectomy (age 6). Radiation as above.
Meds: vitamin D3 2000 units daily, OTC.
Allergies: none to drugs.
Social: never smoked. Wine once or twice a month. Lives in Belchertown, walks and runs most days, eats a lot of produce.
Gyn: regular cycles, Pap last year at prior office, she believes normal.
Imm: thinks she is up to date, had both COVID shots this spring; records coming.

ROS negative x 12 systems.

Exam: NAD. HEENT clear. Neck supple, no thyroid enlargement or nodes. Heart RRR no murmur. Lungs clear. Abd soft, healed L flank/transverse scar, nontender, no masses or organomegaly. Breasts: deferred today, she prefers to defer, gets imaging. Skin no rashes. Ext no edema. Neuro nonfocal.

A/P
1. BRCA2 carrier - continue annual breast MRI; order placed for November so it lines up with her prior cycle. Mammography to start at 30. Will revisit ovarian planning in a few years, she is not ready to talk about it now.
2. Hx Wilms tumor s/p L nephrectomy and abdominopelvic RT - solitary kidney: yearly creatinine and UA, avoid NSAIDs regularly. Will look up the long-term follow-up guidance for childhood radiation once old records arrive.
3. Health maintenance - CBC, CMP, lipids, UA, HIV and hep C screen today. Flu shot in October. PHQ-2 0.
4. Vitamin D - continue her supplement.
Release signed, request faxed to prior PCP. RTC 1 yr.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Hi Erin, all of your bloodwork came back fine. Kidney function is normal for one kidney, blood counts, liver tests and cholesterol are all where they should be, and the HIV and hepatitis C screens were negative. Urine was clean. Nothing to do until your MRI in November.

reports.text: Specimen: ThinPrep liquid-based cervical cytology. Specimen adequacy: satisfactory for evaluation, transformation zone component present.
reports.conclusion: Negative for intraepithelial lesion or malignancy.

reports.study: MRI breast, bilateral, with and without contrast
reports.text: Indication: high-risk screening, BRCA2 mutation carrier. Technique: bilateral breast MRI with and without IV gadolinium. Breast composition: heterogeneous fibroglandular tissue. Background parenchymal enhancement: minimal, symmetric. No suspicious mass, non-mass enhancement or focus. No axillary adenopathy.
reports.conclusion: No MRI evidence of malignancy. BI-RADS 1, negative. Continue annual high-risk screening.

documents.title: Prior Primary Care Records
documents.author: outside primary care
documents.body:
Records received by fax from prior primary care office, 41 pages, covering 2014 to 2021.

Contents: office notes; problem list (BRCA2 carrier, history of Wilms tumor s/p left nephrectomy and radiation); genetic testing report dated 06/2017: heterozygous pathogenic variant in BRCA2 detected, BRCA1 negative, post-test counseling note attached; breast MRI reports 2018, 2019 and 11/2020, all BI-RADS 1; Pap 03/2020 negative; immunization history (childhood series complete, HPV series completed 2008, Tdap 08/2019, COVID-19 Pfizer x2 spring 2021). No pediatric oncology treatment summary in the packet.

Abstracted to chart by MA. Routed to PCP.

documents.title: Outside Records Review
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Reviewed old chart. Matches what she told me. BRCA2 report confirmed. Imaging cycle is November. No oncology treatment summary; she will ask her mother whether the family kept one. Nothing to act on.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: In after school for flu vaccine. No fever today, no prior reactions. Quadrivalent flu 0.5 mL IM L deltoid, lot recorded. VIS given. Tolerated well, left after 15 minutes.

reports.study: MRI breast, bilateral, with and without contrast
reports.text: Indication: annual high-risk screening, BRCA2 mutation carrier. Comparison: 11/05/2020. Technique: bilateral breast MRI before and after IV gadolinium, with subtraction and kinetic analysis. Breast composition: heterogeneous fibroglandular tissue. Background parenchymal enhancement: minimal, symmetric. No suspicious enhancing mass or non-mass enhancement in either breast. Skin and nipples normal. No axillary or internal mammary adenopathy. Incidental: none.
reports.conclusion: Negative bilateral breast MRI. BI-RADS 1. Recommend continued annual screening MRI.

documents.title: MRI Result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Erin - breast MRI was negative, same as last year. I'll put the next one in for November 2022.

documents.title: School Health Form
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Hi, my district is asking every staff member to turn in a health and immunization form by March 1. Could someone fill out the immunization part? I'm uploading the PDF. Thank you!

documents.title: Re: School Health Form
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Form completed from your immunization record and signed. It's attached here and a copy is in your chart.

documents.title: Annual Preventive Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Yearly visit. End of the school year crunch, otherwise good. No GI, GU or breast symptoms. Sleeping fine. Running 3x/wk.

Meds: D3 2000 daily. NKDA. Never smoker, wine rarely.
FHx unchanged from last year.

Exam: well appearing. Heart and lungs normal. Abdomen soft, old L flank scar, no mass, no tenderness. Breast exam: no masses, skin or nipple changes, no axillary nodes bilaterally. Thyroid normal. Skin clear.

A/P
- BRCA2: MRI 11/2021 negative; next due November, ordered. Mammo starts at 30.
- Solitary kidney: Cr and UA today.
- Pap due 2023.
- PHQ-2 0.
- Flu and COVID booster at a fall nurse visit.
See in a year.

documents.title: Lab Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Labs normal. Creatinine stable for a single kidney, urine without protein or blood. Message sent to patient.

documents.title: Immunization Visit
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Flu (quadrivalent) R deltoid and Pfizer bivalent booster L deltoid. Screening questions negative. Observed 15 min, no reaction. Next flu due fall 2023.

reports.study: MRI breast, bilateral, with and without contrast
reports.text: Clinical history: BRCA2 carrier, annual screening. Prior exam 11/09/2021 available for comparison. Multiplanar pre- and post-contrast imaging of both breasts obtained. Heterogeneously dense fibroglandular tissue with minimal symmetric background enhancement, unchanged. No mass, no non-mass enhancement, no suspicious focus. Lymph nodes normal in size and morphology.
reports.conclusion: BI-RADS 1: negative. Return to annual MRI screening.

documents.title: MRI Result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: MRI negative again. Have a good Thanksgiving.

documents.title: Re: MRI Result
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Thanks, always a relief. You too!
